text.title: Коротко
lines: The Lazortron MK II. is a Proto Troop that is unlocked after building the Proto Troop Workshop.
The Lazortron has average hitpoints and and DPS at long range, with overshooting attacks that pierce its initial target, causing damage to all targets in its line of fire, including friendly units.
Howerver Mines, Boom Mine and Shock Mine won't be triggered in the manner of Laser Ranger on contact.
Each Lazortron MK II. costs 6 Gunboat Energy to deploy.

text.title: Как атаковать
lines: The Lazortron MK II. can outrange the vast majority of all defenses with only a few exceptions, which is further bolstered by their piercing attacks that can even clear Mines or chip and eventually destroy defenses they are normally unable to reach. On the other hand, it has no hopes of defeating most that do outrange it, such as Boom Cannons and most Prototype Defenses, at least not without Gunboat support. Shock Launchers can even stun it, greatly reducing its DPS.
Lazortron MKII.s can outrange Sniper Towers and Mortars, but just barely. If too many attack at once, some might get pushed into range.
Lazortron MK II.s should be typically paired with Medics and Dr. Kavan, who can help to stave off damage from Rocket Launchers.
The lasers' friendly fire, in general, is of little to no concern. Anything that gets ahead of a Lazortron MK II. should never be used alongside it in the first place.

text.title: Как обороняться
lines: Spread out buildings to prevent Lazortron MK II.'s attacks from sniping too many structures at once for free Gunboat Energy, and carefully arrange its counters so they cannot be easily neutralized. Boom Cannons and Shock Launchers tend to be priority targets if no Prototype Defenses are present. Various Mines are only effective when closer to shore, as the lasers can potentially snipe them too.

text.title: Интересное
lines: You can have a maximum of 16 Lazortron MK II. in a complete set of fully upgraded Landing Crafts.
The Scorcher (death explosion), Incinerator (death explosion), MegaScorcher (death explosion), Lazortron, Rain Maker and Grenadier are currently the only troops that can damage other friendly troops.

When Lazortron MK. II was introduced, they could be purchased from the Trader as part of an additional offer after the Armory is upgraded to at least level 14. Each purchase authorizes usage of the Lazortron for 1 day.
The lasers cannot exceed the map's boundaries.
The Lazortron MK II. is the only laser-based troop that does not increase its beam extension when upgraded.

text.title: Коротко
lines: Rain Maker is a Proto Troop that is unlocked after building the Proto Troop Workshop.

The Rain Maker has low health and speed, but fires a salvo of 4 cluster munitions from extreme range, each of which land randomly around the target before splitting into 5 submunitions, followed by a long reload time.
All of Rain Maker's projectiles inflict indiscriminate splash damage in their AoE that can set off Mines, Boom Mines, and Shock Mines.
Each Rain Maker costs 6 Gunboat Energy to deploy.
Rain Maker originally cost 15 Gunboat Energy to deploy.

text.title: Как атаковать
lines: Groups of Rain Makers can wreck havoc and deal consistent damage by virtue of their massive range, crippling if not outright obliterating groups of them in one or two volleys, leaving them with no opportunity to retaliate. Much like Grenadiers, buildings near the primary target can also be quickly whittled down to reduce or eliminate their threat.

However, like how Grenadiers work against Cannons and Bombardiers versus Sniper Towers or Mortars, this is a minuscule range advantage. If you have too many Rain Makers, some of them can be pushed into range and may be destroyed immediately.
The Rain Maker's shells can clear Mines around their impact area for them to advance later. This, however, doesn't work well with troops that have lower range due to friendly fire.
If positioned correctly, the only normal defenses able to hit the Rain Maker are the Rocket Launcher and Shock Launcher. This means that use of Medics can be helpful to mitigate damage.
Due to its vulnerability to the Shock Launcher and some Prototype Defenses, it is best to counter them with Gunboat weaponry.

Rain Makers combined with Smoke Screen are a powerful combination, as they instantly launch their cluster munitions at buildings as soon as the Smoke Screen expires, allowing them to deal a massive amount of damage in a split second. If the player then immediately throws another Smoke Screen on them, they can deal heavy damage to the base without becoming vulnerable to the defenses.

text.title: Как обороняться
lines: As mentioned above, Shock Launchers are an effective defense against the Rain Maker.
Certain Prototype Defenses generally work well against Rain Makers.
Shock Blasters, Doom Cannons, S.I.M.O.s and Grapplers can reach them easily and dismiss their range advantage.
Lazor Beam can slowly do chip damage as well, but this is generally ineffective, as Medics are often used to out-heal any damage dealt to them.

Hot Pot and Boom Surprise cannot be targeted or damaged by Rain Makers when sheltered. However, an opponent can force them into the open with other means, resulting in them falling quickly alongside any other defenses.
Damage Amplifiers can be used to boost any other defenses strong against Rain Makers.
Take care to spread out buildings as the Rain Maker's cluster munitions can inflict widespread collateral damage.

Having a beach base (a base where defensive buildings cover the beach) can prove useful against Rain Makers. Unless they have sufficient Gunboat Energy to flank, the Rain Maker will be unable to fully utilize its range advantage.

text.title: Интересное
lines: You can have a maximum of 16 Rain Makers in a complete set of fully upgraded Landing Crafts.
The Scorcher (death explosion), Incinerator (death explosion), MegaScorcher (death explosion), Lazortron, Rain Maker and Grenadier are currently the only troops that can damage other friendly troops.
Rain Maker Blueprint
The March 2020 Update added some Proto Troops to the game and standardized existing Proto Troops to fit the Proto Token upgrade system.

Originally, the Rain Maker required blueprints which could be purchased from the Trader as part of an additional offer, once the Armory had been upgraded to at least level 14. These blueprints allowed the Rain Maker to be used for one day.
The Rain Maker's shells are reused assets from high-level Mortars.
The Rain Maker has the highest combined shell & shrapnel damage of all troops.

While under the effects of the best Troop Damage Masterpiece and 12 Guardians boosted with Power Powder, Sgt. Brick's level 6 Battle Orders, and Dr. Vitamin's Boost, a maxed Rain Maker can deliver up to 19,024.2 combined damage for a single shell or 76,096.8 combined damage for full burst.

If the opponent also has the best Troop Damage Masterpiece (32%) and 12 Guardians (13% each) (all boosted with Power Powder for +188% damage), and the player attacks using the Engraving Intel at max level, a maxed Rain Maker can deliver up to 25,623 combined damage for a single shell or 102,492 combined damage for full burst.
The Rain Maker is featured as a boss in the now-defunct Squad Busters, another Supercell game, where it is piloted by a Rifleman instead.
The Rain Maker is the only troop that fires instantly as soon as the Smoke Screen ends.

text.title: Коротко
lines: The Critter Cannon MK II. is a Proto Troop that is unlocked after building the Proto Troop Workshop.
The Critter Cannon MK II. fires a salvo of Critters, one at a time, at buildings from a long range.
The Critter Cannon MK II. has a large random radius, meaning it shoots Critters in a large scatter around the target building.
A Critter Cannon MK II. costs 6 Gunboat Energy to deploy.
Her Critters are considered NPC units.

text.title: Как атаковать
lines: Unlike the Rain Maker, the Critter Cannon MK II. can only barely outrange Boom Cannons. However, it can distract the Boom Cannon with its Critters if it targets a nearby building.

Aside from the Boom Cannon, the only regular defenses able to hit it are the Rocket Launcher and Shock Launcher. In this case, Medics or Dr. Kavan can be helpful to heal off the damage, especially considering that both of these defenses have a blind spot which prevents them from being distracted by the Critters spawned if they are targeted.

As Critters did not receive any DPS or HP boost from Magma Statues back then, Critter Cannon MK II. generally had subpar damage output and lacked the durability to take on many bases by themselves due to their long delay between bursts.
Shock Launchers and certain prototype defenses should be priority targets for Artillery or Barrage to prevent them from defeating or delaying Critter Cannons.
Pairing DPS units with the Critter Cannon MK II. is a valid option, as it can provide distractions at range and thereby extend their lifespan.
It is best to let the Critter Critter Cannon MK II. target buildings that are not in range of Flamethrowers or Machine Guns as an excessive build-up of Critters can be hard to stop.

Smoking the Critter Cannon MK II. when they are at Flamethrowers can make them overwhelmed, as they get surrounded. However, doing so will mean that they don't distract the defenses and may cause the Critter Cannons MK II. to be targeted.
Shocking defenses can be helpful as it allows a build-up of Critters, but be wary that you do not shock your Critters.
The Critters can get chip damage on every defense, which is slow but sure progress. They can prevent deadly defenses from hitting your troops or support an attacking troop with extra damage.

text.title: Как обороняться
lines: Prototype Defenses are helpful, especially the Shock Blaster, Doom Cannon and Grappler. They can stall their attacks, outright obliterate them and drag them into the line of fire.
Take care to place Boom Mines away from buildings so Critters can't walk over it and activate it.
Shock Launchers can delay the already low rate of fire of Critter Cannon MK II. and cause time to run out.
Placing buildings as lures can cause Critter Cannon MK II. to fire and turn in 1 direction and allow Boom Cannons to start to target them.

Placing high level Flamethrowers and Machine Guns can be helpful in destroying lots of Critters quickly, which will easily stall the Critter Cannons' progress. However, these defenses in such a position can be taken advantage of by attackers using Grenadiers or Tanks.
Mines can take out Critters en masse.

text.title: Коротко
lines: Seekers are special troops usable only on Warships.

Seekers prioritize core buildings, such as Engine Rooms and Headquarters, above all else. If these targets are not available, they will proceed to engage the closest threat, akin to most other troops.
Seekers cannot be healed and are not affected by Flares.
Seekers’s attack frequency increases as its health drops.
When it has 100% of his hitpoints, its attack frequency is 0.5 seconds.
When its hitpoints are between 99% and 75%, its attack frequency is 0.45 seconds.
When its hitpoints are between 75% and 50%, its attack frequency is 0.4 seconds.
When its hitpoints are between 50% and 25%, its attack frequency is 0.35 seconds.
When it has less than 25% of his hitpoints, its attack frequency is 0.3 seconds.

text.title: Как атаковать
lines: Seekers are very difficult to learn and master. Careful Use Smoke Screens, Shock Bombs, Critters and other, durable troops like Heavy Choppas and Heavies are critical to successful attacks with them.
Their inability to follow Flares allow other troops to be redirected without hampering the attack much.

text.title: Как обороняться
lines: Place your Engine Rooms as far from to each other as it possible. Think about the path of Seekers and place your defenses in the way.

Flamethrowers and Machine Guns near Engine Rooms will force the opponent to reconsider their Seeker placement. Point defenses can also be effective against small groups of Seekers, as they are unlikely to survive a hit or two.
Shock Launchers are particularly valuable for impeding Seekers in conjunction with other defenses. Space them out and ensure the opponent has to waste GBE trying to work around them.

text.title: Интересное
lines: Seekers were first introduced on Warship season 4.
Seekers are the only troop to prioritize a specific type of building.
A maximum of 64 Seekers can be deployed in a complete set of fully upgraded Landing Crafts on Warships. This does not include any Seekers spawned by Cpt. Ruddero's Seeker Shot ability.
This number increases to 80 in Season 68, as Landing Crafts could be upgraded to level 26, rather than 22, allowing each to carry two more Seekers.
Seeker is the only Proto Troop that can't be trained in the Proto Troop Workshop.
Along with the Undercover Rifleman and the Clone Rifleman, the Seeker was one of the first Proto Troops available in the Bunker during Warships Season 78.
Before 15 September 2026, they could not be revived by Second Wind or Remote Defib.

text.title: Коротко
lines: The Heavy Choppa is a flying troop formerly available exclusively on Warships from Season 5 onwards, then implemented as a Proto Troop.
The Heavy Choppa is unlocked after building the Proto Troop Workshop.
Heavy Choppas are durable and fast aerial units with low range and DPS, as well as the ability to spawn Heavies .
It periodically deploys a Heavy every 5 seconds, up to a maximum of 10 times for a total of 10 Heavies.
When destroyed, it deals damage in a small area and spawns 8 Heavies.
Heavy Choppa is one of 4 aerial units alongside Cpt. Ruddero, Rocket Choppa and RC-CMD-013.
As an aerial unit, it exhibits the following properties:
It does not interact with Traps, and cannot be targeted by certain Defenses/Prototype Defenses.
It can be resurrected by Dr. Kavan's Second Wind ability, Remote Defib and Mind Control but won't spawn Heavies.
It can bypass unplayable zones in Warships, the Mega Crab and Mega Turtle by simply flying over them.
It cannot be stunned by Shock Bombs, but all other Gunboat Weaponry that affect troops, such as Artillery and Medkit, will interact with it normally.
It is unaffected by Speed Serum, but the spawned Heavies can be affected.
Each Heavy Choppa costs 8 Gunboat Energy to deploy.

text.title: Как атаковать
lines: Heavy Choppas work quite well with Rocket Choppas because of their flying ability, similar movement speed as well as complimenting the high damage of the Rocket Choppas with high health and short range to soak up a majority of the damage.
Watch out for Doom Cannons because they can wipe out your Heavy Choppas. Grapplers near Cannons will achieve a similar effect.

Heavy Choppas work quite well with Bombardiers as well due to their action of dropping Heavies. Make sure Rocket Launchers and Shock Launchers do not target your Bombardiers though, since the Heavy Choppas and Heavies will stand in the blind spots of these defenses.

If you have not unlocked Bombardiers yet, you can use Zookas instead. They work the same way as a standard composition of Heavies and Zookas, except that in this case the Heavies' cover is much stronger.

text.title: Как обороняться
lines: Choosing Grapplers or Doom Cannons on the Tech Tree will greatly improve your success against Heavy Choppas. Additionally, placing Sky Shields near your Engine Rooms will prevent enemies from flaring directly to them.

For the main base, a good decision is to place some heavy defenses such as Doom Cannons, Boom Cannons and regular Cannons in order to destroy as many Heavy Choppas as possible before they could spawn a lot of Heavies.

Hot Pots, Microwav'rs and Flamethrowers can help defend when Heavy Choppas have already spawned many Heavies. These defensive buildings have significant damage value and splash damage which help them deal with a big number of short-range units.

text.title: Интересное
lines: You can have a maximum of 16 Heavy Choppas in a complete set of fully upgraded Landing Crafts.
Despite its landed sprite having 3 blades per rotor, the Heavy Choppa has 4 blades per rotor while flying.
The Heavy Choppa would not be able to fly in real life because both rotors spin in the same direction.
Defeated Heavies deployed from Heavy Choppas do not count as casualties.

Heavies dropped by Heavy Choppas used to be able to be revived by Mind Control and Dr. Kavan's Second Wind ability, but both lost the ability to do so in the update where fallen troops could only be revived once, as opposed to infinite times.
Originally, aerial units were a ruled-out idea, but they were added later anyway.
Before 15 September 2026, Heavy Choppa could not be revived by Second Wind, Remote Defib or Mind Control.

text.title: Коротко
lines: The Turret Engineer is a Proto Troop that is unlocked after building the Proto Troop Workshop.
The Turret Engineer periodically deploys stationary turrets.
There is no maximum number of Turrets the Engineer can spawn.
The Turret Engineer and his Turret are considered NPC units.

text.title: Как атаковать
lines: Turret Engineers should always be accompanied by meatshields or other means to distract/neutralize defenses, as they could not hope to overwhelm any on their own with the turrets' low DPS.
Heroes like Cpt. Everspark or Pvt. Bullit can distract defenses and give the engineers more time to deploy Turrets.

text.title: Как обороняться
lines: Defense like Cannon, Boom Cannon or Doom Cannon can annihilate the Turrets quickly.
Defense like Machine Gun or Flamethrower can also be effective against the Turrets.
Buildings with high range like Boom Cannons, Grappler or Shock Blaster can kill the Turret Engineer before he can throw the first Turret.
Mortar, Rocket Launcher and Shock Launcher can target your engineers if the Turrets are in their blind spots.
Unlike the Critter Engineer, Turret Engineers cannot clear mines effectively, which is favorable for mines.

text.title: Интересное
lines: You can have a maximum of 24 Turret Enginners in a complete set of fully upgraded Landing Crafts.
Note: Having this many Turret Engineers is highly discouraged because the Turrets can easily destroyed by most Defences leaving the Engineers unprotected.
Turrets deployed by the Turret Engineer have 1.6 tiles more range than the Deployable Turret.
The Health of the deployed Turret cannot be boosted by Magma Statues, but its Damage can.

text.title: Коротко
lines: The CryoBombardier is a Proto Troop that is unlocked after building the Proto Troop Workshop.
The CryoBombardier throws ice bombs at enemy buildings from a very long range, and slows attack rates of targeted buildings by 50%.
The CryoBombardier additionally applies the Corrosion effect, allowing other troops to deal 10% more damage to the defense.
A CryoBombardier costs 1 Gunboat Energy to deploy.

text.title: Как атаковать
lines: The CryoBombardier provides an alternative to the Cryoneer or Bombardier, combining their abilities.

Like Cryoneers, they often spread out and target in a way as to maximize the number of frozen buildings, switching between targets that are directly in front of them. However, their ice bombs only affect one target at a time, unlike the Cryoneer's beams which can freeze multiple buildings in a line.

The CryoBombardier still does high damage per second, but not as high as the normal Bombardier. Also, their slightly different AI (and slightly lower health) means they can be slightly more vulnerable than normal Bombardiers.
CryoBombardiers are very fragile and taken out easily by most defenses. However, they can outrange most defenses, including the Sniper Tower.
Boom Cannons, Rocket Launchers, and most Prototype Defenses pose a threat to exposed CryoBombardiers.
CryoBombardiers' slowing effect can be used in conjunction with troops that have the potential to deal more damage, such as the Zooka. They can work well with Tanks, Grenadiers and other Bombardiers.

Keep in mind that CryoBombardiers have similar weaknesses as Zookas have. For example, using a Flare when using Bombardiers with Heavies on a Rocket Launcher will move the Heavies in the blind spot which the CryoBombardiers won't enter, thus allowing the Rocket Launcher to fire on the CryoBombardiers.

text.title: Как обороняться
lines: Avoid placing exposed Flamethrowers, Machine Guns or Cannons on the front lines without any protection, as Bombardiers are able to outrange all three. Depending on the warship layout, placing them at the edge just before a landing zone may still work if placed properly.
Placing non-defensive buildings can distract CryoBombardiers from targeting and slowing down defensive buildings.
Several Prototype Defenses can work well against the CryoBombardier:

The Shock Blaster, Lazor Beam, Doom Cannon and Grappler can all easily reach CryoBombardiers. In the first three cases, CryoBombardiers can be finished off quickly by the prototype, while the Grappler can nullify the CryoBombardiers' range advantage by pulling them close. However, in cases where the CryoBombardiers are backed by meat shields, the Lazor Beam will typically be the only prototype that can consistently hit them.

The Hot Pot and Boom Surprise are largely immune to the CryoBombardier's range advantage due to their nature of hiding until enemies are close, and thus can also make good choices. However, in cases where the CryoBombardiers are backed by meat shields, both prototypes can be distracted easily.
S.I.M.O.s are an excellent prototype choice to defend against CryoBombardiers, as they will target CryoBombardiers in the absence of Critters or other low-health distractions.

Note that the CryoBombardiercan outrange both the Microwav'r and Flotsam Cannon, though in the latter case the death damage can be useful to finish off CryoBombardiers if the attacker is not paying attention.

text.title: Интересное
lines: The name 'CryoBombardier' is a fusion between 'Cryo' (the Greek prefix for "cold") and 'Bombardier'.
You can have a maximum of 24 Crybombardiers in a complete set of fully upgraded Landing Crafts.
According to his uniform, he is a corporal.

text.title: Коротко
lines: The CryoTank is a Proto Troop that is unlocked after building the Proto Troop Workshop.
A CryoTank costs 8 Gunboat Energy to deploy.
Cryotanks behave similarly to Lazortrons, but trade damage for the ability to freeze buildings for 6 seconds, reducing their attack rate.

text.title: Как атаковать
lines: Due to their abysmally low damage and decent range, CryoTanks are best used as support. Much like the Cryoneer, its freeze beam's range can cripple several turrets at once, allowing the rest of your troops to live much longer.

text.title: Как обороняться
lines: The CryoTank itself isn't dangerous and is in fact outranged by several defenses, such as Sniper Towers, Rocket Launchers and Boom Cannons. The real threat it poses is the fire rate penalty that effectively reduces their DPS by a percentage, meaning spaced-out structures are less vulnerable to its attacks, though this does leave them open other units that may accompany it.

text.title: Интересное
lines: A maximum of 16 CryoTanks can be deployed in a complete set of fully upgraded Landing Crafts.
Originally they needed 18 Gunboat Energy to deploy, making them the most energy expensive units to ever exist, with a maximum cost of 288 energy for a full set of 16 Cryotanks.

After their cost had been reduced to 8 per unit they now share the highest energy cost with Scorchers and Heavy Choppas: 8 per unit, 16 per level 24 and above Landing Craft, 128 energy for a full army.
For Landing Crafts below level 24 the MegaScorcher holds the record for the highest cost, at 12 per unit, 96 for a full set of 8 level 23 and below Landing Crafts.

text.title: Коротко
lines: Dr. Vitamin is a Proto Troop that is unlocked after building the Proto Troop Workshop.

He lacks any offense of his own, instead throwing vitamins which heals all other allied units and temporarily apply multiple Buffs such as Attack Speed Boost, Damage Boost and reduced damage taken. They will not intentionally target each other.

text.title: Как атаковать
lines: Dr. Vitamin is similar to the old Dr. Vitamin, but in addition to boosting DPS, he now also provides a speed boost and reduces incoming damage while healing. This sounds practical on paper for Tank/Grenadier-based strategies, which already include Medics, as their DPS units are capable of withstanding some fire. Unlike his old version, the new Dr. Vitamin can be more effective against point defenses such as Boom Cannons, since troops not only shoot faster and harder but also take less damage from enemy defenses, allowing them to deal more sustained damage to those structures.

He can be entirely gone without in strategies that feature units that with low health or range, such as Zookas or Scorchers, as frail units are easily destroyed before he could even heal, whereas lower-ranged units put him in the line of fire, and using him contributes little to their overall damage.
Since Dr. Vitamins cannot intentionally target each other, the use of Medics is still recommended to prevent ranged enemy defenses from accumulating damage.
It is still possible to flank with Dr. Vitamin by directing troops into Mines, causing them to immediately follow said damaged troops, rather than the closest ones.
Dr. Vitamin is an extremely useful support unit for Operations, as its boost allows troops to deal heavy damage while taking less damage from defenses.

text.title: Как обороняться
lines: Make sure you protect your Cannons and Boom Cannons, as these could be your only chance of surviving a Dr. Vitamin-Tank/Heavy-Zooka attack.

As with the Medic, a Grappler can entirely deter players from using formations reliant on Dr. Vitamin, as the Grappler will typically drag all of their large units into a group of other defenses, which in turn can destroy them in seconds or critically blunt an assault.
Killing a Dr. Vitamin is only slightly easier than a Medic. While Rocket Launchers and Mortars can whittle them down alone, the use of Medics alongside them can potentially nullify their impact.

text.title: Что меняется с уровнем
lines: There are no visual changes between levels, but each upgrade increases Dr. Vitamin's hitpoints (by 8.8%), HPS (Healing per Second) (by 1).

text.title: Интересное
lines: For some reason, Dr. Vitamin is able to affect mechanical units such as the Tank.
You can have a maximum of 48 Drs. Vitamin in a complete set of fully upgraded Landing Crafts.
Note: Having this many Drs. Vitamin is highly discouraged as your troops will have no offensive capabilities unless you bring heroes.
The vitamins thrown at troops appear as blue and red colored pills.

Although a Mind Controlled Dr. Vitamin is unable to target buildings, if a unit he's targeting is close enough that the building is hit by the vitamins, the building will still be affected by the buffs, but it won't recover HP.

Dr. Vitamin was initially proposed with multiple unique variants that carried varying functionality before the developers settled with one that consolidates all their features. These variants have the following attributes:
Increases unit attack speed.
Heals units and increases their attack speed.
Heals units and increases their damage.
Heals units and provides damage reduction.

text.title: Коротко
lines: The Hidden Warrior is a Proto Troop that performs similarly to the Warrior, with high speed, good damage, and self-healing attacks, although they require more capacity than their counterparts when deployed on Warships.
They move faster then Warriors, but have a slower hit speed (1.1s > 1s) and 11% less range.

Hidden Warriors are not visible to enemy buildings by default and will not be fired upon directly until they break stealth when attacking, and will re-engage stealth if they do not attack or take damage for 2.5 seconds.
S.I.M.O. and Microwav'r are not affected by their stealth.

text.title: Как атаковать
lines: Hidden Warriors are designed with the Smokey Warrior strategy in mind, minus the smoke. Their stealth allows them to reach enemy buildings even at a range disadvantage, negating the frequent need for smoke and allowing you to focus on paralyzing or distracting other defenses. This means they can often work alone, without the presence of other troops, but it requires careful and strategic planning.
Heroes can still be used alongside Hidden Warriors this way, but unless they're able to survive the trip to the target unprotected, it would still be wise to defend your Hero with smoke.
Other sources of support are still appreciated, primarily those from your Gunboat. Smoke may not be useful, but just about anything else would be.

Since Microwav'rs won't attack Hidden Warriors, you don't have to use a Shock Bomb to stun the Microwav'r. However, the Microwav'r can still hit them through its omnidirectional attacks if another target gets into range.

Their stealth makes it much easier to counter the range advantage enemy defenses might have, as they will be unable to acquire a target and can be easily worked around. That being said, they will inevitably pose an issue if the Hidden Warriors end up within their line of fire.
Try to work around or set off any mines you might find.

text.title: Как обороняться
lines: Hidden Warriors may force you to rethink your defensive strategy as they're able to bypass defenses. Unless a building is able to keep them occupied long enough, they may take some serious damage, and their target is more often than not obliterated by large amounts of direct damage immediately.

While the S.I.M.O. is already a dangerous deterrent, Mines and Boom Mines shouldn't be dismissed either, as stealth has no effect on them. Beware that Shock Mines are less effective, as they can neither deal sufficient damage or disable their stealth.
Speaking of stunning, any source can be viable if the Hidden Warriors are actually exposed, since it then renders them vulnerable as per usual.

Due to the increased unit capacity, defenses with high quantities of direct damage (Cannon/Boom Cannon/Doom Cannon) can also work if they cover likely targeted buildings. Anything with a blindspot or insufficient output will simply never get a clean hit.

text.title: Интересное
lines: Hidden Warrior was introduced with Warships Season 42, later returning in Seasons 43, 61, 68 and 75.
The Hidden Warriors had fewer troops available at the first and second levels relative to the amount a maxed Landing Craft could hold until Season 73.

A maximum of 48 Hidden Warriors can be deployed in a complete set of fully upgraded Landing Crafts. However, having this many is not often a viable strategy, as they are much more difficult to use with their increased capacity.
Hidden Warrior's in-game model is identical to the Warrior.

At the lower levels, the Hidden Warrior heals for 25% of the damage dealt, and this percentage gradually decreases at higher levels. This is why certain levels have higher self-heal values than the following level.

text.title: Коротко
lines: MegaScorcher is a Proto Troop that is unlocked after building the Proto Troop Workshop.
MegaScorcher behaves similarly to Scorchers, constantly changing targets and setting them on fire with its short-ranged omnidirectional attacks.
When destroyed, the MegaScorcher deals heavy damage in a small area of effect and launches multiple fireballs into the sky, damaging troops and buildings on contact with a residual burn effect.
Each MegaScorcher costs 12 Gunboat Energy to deploy.

text.title: Как атаковать
lines: Due to the MegaScorcher's massive size, high energy cost, low reserve capacity and DPS, using them alone can be unwise. DPS units like Zookas, Laser Rangers, and Bombardiers should be brought along to quickly destroy other buildings while it takes the heat.

Like the Heavy and Scorcher, MegaScorcher boasts incredible high health but terrible DPS for the space it takes, so it is best used as a distraction to protect other low health but high DPS boasting troops.
Similar to the Scorcher or Incinerator, the MegaScorcher also moves further into the base because it changes targets every few seconds
If you want the MegaScorchers to attack one particular building without them switching madly, the best thing to do would be to use a Flare to direct the MegaScorchers manually.

MegaScorchers may not work as well with units that use ice-based effects, such as Cryoneers, CryoBombardier and the CryoTank, as its incendiary attacks can defrost affected defenses and remove the fire rate penalty while torching them randomly.

text.title: Как обороняться
lines: Place your point defenses well to minimize the impact of MegaScorchers, as they can do heavy damage to dense clusters of defenses by burning several at once.
Make sure it is hard to avoid most of your Boom Mines. They can deal decent damage to MegaScorchers.
The Doom Cannon is very effective at picking off MegaScorchers as it boasts immense damage.

text.title: Интересное
lines: MegaScorcher has the highest hitpoints of all Troops (including Heroes)
While under the effects of the best Troop Health Masterpiece, 12 Guardians (all boosted with Power Powder), a maxed MegaScorcher has 799,480 health.

If the opponent also has the best Troop Health Masterpiece and 12 Guardians (all boosted with Power Powder), and the player attacks using the Engraving Intel at max level, this can even go up to 1,120,220 health, the highest number achievable out of all troops.

However, the MegaScorcher is not the only troop that can potentially endure over a million damage, as Pvt. Bullit's Hero Perk and Taunt ability can limit damage dealt to him in a single hit, which massively increases the amount of effective damage he can absorb.

This is particularly noticeable in Colonel Gearheart's War Factory events, where Ice Statue/Damage Amplifier boosts are so high that MegaScorchers with the highest possible health will perish in a few hits from Boom Cannons and Doom Cannons, whereas a level 1 Bullit with no boosts can withstand up to 59 hits from the same defenses while under the effect of a level 1 Taunt (60 hits are required to deal 18 000 damage to a level 1 Bullit while he's taunting). (Note that as with most NPC bases, the War Factory doesn't have Magma Statues, so MegaScorchers can't have their health boosted to over 1 million).
The MegaScorcher was introduced on Warship Season 63 before being implemented as a prototype troop, eventually superseding the Incinerator on July 1, 2024.
The MegaScorcher has the highest unit size of all troops, at 17.
Despite this, the MegaScorcher is not the biggest unit ever introduced in the game, as Scorchers had a size of 21 when they were first introduced in the game.

The MegaScorcher currently has the highest individual energy cost of all troops, at 12, the same energy cost of the original Scorcher, but lower than the 18 energy cost of the original CryoTank; the other 3 original Tank Based Prototroops also had an energy cost of 12.

Despite the MegaScorcher having the highest individual cost, Scorchers, the current CryoTank and Heavy Choppas cost 16 energy to be deployed in pairs from level 24 and above Landing Crafts, while the other 3 current Tank based Prototroops, plus Mech have a cost of 12 energy per level 24 and above Landing Crafts.
You can have a maximum of 8 MegaScorchers on a complete set of fully upgraded Landing Crafts.
This makes the MegaScorcher the only unit that still can't be deployed in at least pairs, occupying only 136 of 248 available spaces in a set of fully upgraded Landing Crafts.
If Scorchers still had their original size they'd be occupying 168 of 248 available spaces, making them more "efficient" at occupying space than the current MegaScorchers.
The Scorcher (death explosion), Incinerator (death explosion), MegaScorcher (death explosion), Lazortron, Rain Maker and Grenadier are currently the only troops that can damage other friendly troops.

text.title: Коротко
lines: The Melon Bombardier is a Proto Troop that is unlocked after building the Proto Troop Workshop.
The Melon Bombardier launches watermelons at enemy buildings from a very long range.
Each Melon Bombardier costs 1 Gunboat Energy to deploy.
The watermelons split into 3 pieces of shrapnel that each deal damage equivalent to the primary projectile, which will only damage buildings.

text.title: Как атаковать
lines: Melon Bombardiers are identical to Bombardiers in the sense that they are very fragile; most defenses will be capable of defeating them in one hit. Their longer range allows them to outrange Machine Guns and Cannons in addition to Flamethrowers, so none of these should be a threat unless they are cleverly placed.
Melon Bombardiers can also outrange Sniper Towers and Mortars, but just barely. If more than two Melon Bombardiers attack the same Sniper Tower or Mortar, one of them maybe pushed into range.
Boom Cannons and Rocket Launchers are major threats to exposed Melon Bombardiers, as are many Prototype Defenses.
You can protect Melon Bombardiers with Tanks or Heavies to save them from long-ranged Defensive Buildings and Mines.

Much like the Rain Maker and Grenadier, the Melon Bombardier's cluster munitions are exceptionally threatening to clusters of buildings, and can, at times, consistently hit structures behind their target that they would have outranged.

Keep in mind that Melon Bombardiers have similar weaknesses as Zookas have. For example, using a Flare with a Heavy-Melon Bombardiers combo on a Rocket Launcher will move the Heavies into the blind spot which the Melon Bombardiers won't enter, thus allowing the Rocket Launcher to fire on the Melon Bombardiers.
Melon Bombardiers, like Zookas, will target in-range active defenses before targeting support buildings, such as Storages, Power Cores, or Shield Generators, so mind their positioning.

text.title: Как обороняться
lines: The Shock Blaster, Lazor Beam, S.I.M.O. Doom Cannon and Grappler can all easily reach Melon Bombardiers. In the first three cases, Melon Bombardiers can be finished off quickly by the prototype, while the Grappler can nullify the Melon Bombardiers' range advantage by pulling them close. However, in cases where the Melon Bombardiers are backed by meat shields, the Lazor Beam will typically be the only prototype that can consistently hit them.

The Hot Pot and Boom Surprise are largely immune to the Melon Bombardier's range advantage due to their nature of hiding until enemies are close, and thus can also make good choices. However, in cases where the Melon Bombardiers are backed by meat shields, both prototypes can be distracted easily.
S.I.M.O.s are an excellent prototype choice to defend against Melon Bombardiers, as they will target Melon Bombardiers in the absence of Critters or other low-health distractions.

Note that the Melon Bombardier can outrange both the Microwav'r and Flotsam Cannon, though in the latter case the explosion damage of the Flotsam Cannon can be useful to finish off Melon Bombardiers if the attacker is not paying attention.

text.title: Интересное
lines: The Melon Bombardier has the highest DPS of all troops.
While under the effects of the best Troop Damage Masterpiece, 12 Guardians boosted with Power Powder, and maxed out Battle Orders the Melon Bombardier can have up to 29,692.08 DPS.

If the opponent also has the best Troop Damage Masterpiece and 12 Guardians (all boosted with Power Powder), and the player attacks using the Engraving Intel at max level, a maxed Melon Bombardier can have up to 37,414.368 DPS.
You can have a maximum of 24 Melon Bombardiers in a complete set of fully upgraded Landing Crafts.
According to his uniform, he is a corporal.

text.title: Коротко
lines: Protector is a Proto Troop that is unlocked after building the Proto Troop Workshop
The Protector has low health and high speed, able to grant other friendly units Shields.
Shield Points completely negate any damage if the Shield get destroyed.

Only one layer of Shield Points can be active on any troop at any given moment. If multiple Protectors target the same troop, they will merely restore any missing Shield Points instead of granting another layer. This includes other sources of Shield points, and the most recently applied one takes priority.
As a defensive unit, Protector can provide a shield to buildings.

text.title: Как атаковать
lines: Protectors can be used like Medics in compositions with large units, specifically Tanks and Grenadiers. They have enough range to avoid the likes of Machine Guns and Flamethrowers that would normally tear through Shield points quickly. Medics can outheal many area defenses that end up hitting them (such as Rocket Launchers) while Protectors negate hits from enemy point defenses. This, however, may prove inconsistent compared to various other Gunboat abilities that can effectively remove such threats from play.

text.title: Как обороняться
lines: As with Medics, Protectors contribute no damage and rely on supporting other large units, falling quickly if they do come under fire. Various point defenses that counter them will also greatly reduce their effectiveness.

text.title: Интересное
lines: You can have a maximum of 40 Protectors in a complete set of fully upgraded Landing Crafts. Having this many, however, will outright eliminate most if not all of your offensive capabilities.
Originally Shield hitpoints constantly deplete over time. This was changed with the HQ28 Update.

text.title: Коротко
lines: Shockaneer is a Proto Troop that is unlocked after building the Proto Troop Workshop.
Shockaneers fire lightly-damaging electrical beams which stuns enemy buildings and allied units in her way.
They do not deal damage to troops.

text.title: Как атаковать
lines: Use them similarly to Cryoneers. Due to their low damage per second, they are not recommended to be used alone. Combine them with Zookas, Laser Rangers or other high-damage troops to alleviate this.

Since they completely paralyze enemy turrets for several seconds, they are extremely useful for supporting other troop formations like Heavy-Zooka even on bases with very high damage boosts like Gearheart or upper-level Operation bases, unlike Medics whose raw-point-value healing effect gets quickly overpowered in these situations, whereas Shockaneer renders them moot, as damage bonuses are useless if a defense can't attack. The Heavy-Zooka-Shock formation is very, very effective.

Shockaneer are extremely effective in Operations, as the attacker can not only save Gunboat Energy that would have been used for Shock Bombs, but also increase the lifespan of troops, resulting in a higher chance of success.
Unlike Cryoneers, Shockaneers can be safely used with Scorchers as their fire based attacks don't interact with shock-based stun. The Scorchers are still at risk of being stunned.

text.title: Как обороняться
lines: A Shockaneer have moderate health so a Cannon or Boom Cannon can take her down in one shot if it is high-leveled.
Due to this moderate amount of health, a few salvos from a Rocket Launcher or a few shots from Mortars may also work on wiping out a few Shockaneers at once.
Avoid clustering defenses whenever possible because this provides Shockaneers the opportunity to freeze more defenses at once.

text.title: Интересное
lines: Shockaneer's visors are based on the positive/negative electrodes on batteries. This proves that Shock-based attacks in this game were relevant to strong electrical currents.
You can have a maximum of 56 Shockaneers in a complete set of fully upgraded Landing Crafts.
However, bringing them in such a large number would mean next to no offense in your army unless you bring a suitable hero.
The name 'Shockaneer' may be a pun of 'Shock' and either 'Engineer' or 'Pioneer'.

text.title: Коротко
lines: Stunner is a Proto Troop that is unlocked after building the Proto Troop Workshop.
The Stunner makes slow and inaccurate throws at enemy structures from a distance, dealing high damage and stunning anything caught in its large area of effect, preventing it from moving or attacking.

text.title: Как атаковать
lines: Stunners do not work well in their intended role, as their slow attack rate gives the player limited control compared to other, more flexible options, and can also result in friendly fire.

They can be used with other ranged units like Bombardiers, Grenadiers and Medics (which are usually included in strategies with Grenadiers) to minimize friendly fire, but their inaccurate throws often reduce their potency. Even within Grenadier-based compositions, however, Stunners are still of questionable use, since Grenadiers rely on outranging many defenses for maximum effect, and any damage dealt by Rocket Launchers can be promptly healed up by Medics, thereby removing the need to stun them.

text.title: Как обороняться
lines: Stunners are easier to counter than Grenadiers due to their slow attack rate. Defenses that can outrange them like Shock Launchers, Boom Cannons, Rocket Launchers and Sniper Towers will prove vital against them.
Most Prototype Defenses can be effective against Stunners.
The Shock Blaster, Doom Cannon and Grappler all have the necessary range and means to defeat them quickly
The Hot Pot and Boom Surprise cannot outrange Stunners and can be potentially sniped. However, Stunners will not intentionally target them
The Damage Amplifier can be used to boost critical ranged defenses and improve their matchups against Stunners.
As in the case with Shock Bombs, try to space defensive buildings further apart so fewer ones can be disabled at once.
Do not place Economy and Support Buildings in front of your defenses, as an attack that overshot its target can potentially paralyze them.

The Bunker's matchup is generally poor against Stunners. Although immune to stun itself, most garrisoned troops (save for the Bombardier) cannot hit Stunners while inside, and they lose this immunity when upon the Bunker's destruction.

text.title: Интересное
lines: You can have a maximum of 40 Stunners in a complete set of fully upgraded Landing Crafts. However, doing so will outright eliminate most of your offensive capabilities.
The Stunner's old attack occurs in two hits. The first deals 1 damage, but doesn't stun. The second one delivers the effect as expected.
Only his first hit was boosted by the Troop Damage Boost.
Originally, the Stunner had a range of 8 and then 10 Tiles, and he also originally had an Attack Speed of 12.8 seconds.

text.title: Коротко
lines: The Undercover Rifleman is a Proto Troop that performs similarly to the Rifleman, with moderate HP and damage and medium attack range.

Undercover Riflemen are not visible to enemy buildings by default and will not be fired upon directly until they break stealth when attacking, and will re-engage stealth if they do not attack or take damage for 2.5 seconds.
Microwav'r and the S.I.M.O. are not affected by their stealth.

text.title: Как атаковать
lines: Undercover Riflemen are much more comfortable to use than regular Riflemen to a certain extent, since covering them with Smoke Screens will not be always feasible, and their stealth allows them to bypass a number of area defenses that could've otherwise eliminated them on their way, such as Rocket Launchers, which will no longer be able to easily attack them at range.
Heroes can still be used alongside Undercover Riflemen this way, but unless they're able to survive the trip to the target unprotected, it would still be wise to defend your Hero with smoke.
Other sources of support are still appreciated, primarily those from your Gunboat. Smoke may not be useful, but just about anything else would be.

Since Microwav'rs won't attack Undercover Rifleman, you don't have to use a Shock Bomb to stun the Microwav'r. However, the Microwav'r can still hit them through its omnidirectional attacks if another target gets into range.
Try to work around or set off any Mines you might find.

Undercover Riflemen can be deployed in large numbers for maximum effect. This is especially devastating against enemy point defenses (Boom Cannons and to a lesser extent Doom Cannons), as they cannot hope to defeat groups of Riflemen on their own. However, their stealth makes them less than ideal if they are used to shield other units from said defenses.

text.title: Как обороняться
lines: Undercover Riflemen are generally more dangerous than Riflemen, as they position themselves with greater ease when in stealth, giving area defenses little time to react as the opponent does not have to expend energy on Gunboat abilities unnecessarily.

While the S.I.M.O. is already a dangerous deterrent, Mines and Boom Mines shouldn't be dismissed either, as stealth has no effect on them. Beware that Shock Mines are less effective, as they can neither deal sufficient damage or disable their stealth.
Speaking of stunning, any source can be viable if the Undercover Riflemen are actually exposed, since it then renders them vulnerable as per usual.

text.title: Что меняется с уровнем
lines: There are no visual changes between levels, but each upgrade increases the Rifleman's hitpoints (by 7%), DPS (by 8.2%), and training cost.

text.title: Интересное
lines: Offical ingame-Icon
You can have a maximum of 248 Undercover Riflemen if you have a set of fully upgraded Landing Crafts.
The Undercover Rifleman was first introduced in Warships Season 75 and appeared again only in Season 78.
For whatever reason, the in-game version uses the Rifleman artwork instead of the Undercover Rifleman's artwork.

The in-game icon has several visual differences from the original artwork. The eyepatch appears to have been retouched, with the new color partially covering its original shading, while a section of the lower eyepatch still shows the original tone. The left eyebrow also seems to have been repainted, the eyepatch strap appears noticeably thinner than in the original artwork, and the pupil is slightly distorted and off-center. The wiki itself uses a “fixed” image.
Along with the Clone Rifleman and the Seeker, the Undercover Rifleman was one of the first Proto Troops available in the Bunker during Warships Season 78.
Despite appearing in the Beginner's Guide within the Proto Troop Workshop, the Undercover Rifleman isn't available as a trainable Proto Troop.

text.title: Коротко
lines: The Vampire Zooka is a Proto Troop that attacks from a long range and heals herself from her attacks.
Magma Statues do not appear to boost their healing ability.
Vampire Zookas have moderate health and DPS and their range and movement speed are slightly higher than Zookas, but their damage is still overall lower.
The Vampire Zooka is unlocked for players who have an Armory level of 13 or above and starts 1 level below the Armory level. It can be upgraded using Proto Tokens gained from events.

text.title: Как атаковать
lines: Use them similarly to Zookas, but keep in mind that Vampire Zookas are far more self-sufficient due to their life steal. As long as they are continuously dealing damage to heal themselves, they can tank splash damage and even outheal certain defenses.
Keep them attacking whenever possible. If they are forced to move, they temporarily lose survivability since they cannot heal while repositioning. Only Flare when absolutely necessary.

Although Mortars have unimpressive damage per second, their damage per shot is high and splash-based. If Vampire Zookas move into additional defensive fire after being hit, they may be eliminated before they can heal back up.
Take out Rocket Launchers with the Gunboat before deploying your Vampire Zookas. While they can outheal some damage, multiple Rocket Launchers or combined fire can overwhelm them.

When using the Heavy + Vampire Zooka strategy, avoid flaring directly onto a Rocket Launcher. If the Heavies step into the Rocket Launcher's blind spot, it will retarget onto the Vampire Zookas, potentially eliminating them.

Vampire Zookas are less reliant on Medkits or Medics compared to regular Zookas, allowing more flexibility in Gunboat Energy usage. However, Medkits may still be required if they are stalled by certain defenses.

The Flamethrower's range is shorter than the Vampire Zooka's. When positioned correctly, Vampire Zookas can destroy it without taking damage. However, if forced to move or grouped too tightly, some may be pushed into range and eliminated quickly.

Be cautious when attacking a shielded Headquarters or Power Core. Vampire Zookas cannot heal from attacking shields. If they are taking damage from defenses like a Rocket Launcher while hitting shields, they will not recover and can die quickly. Reposition if necessary.Needs to be confirmed

Always look for "Zooka pockets" — positions where Vampire Zookas can hit key buildings (Headquarters, Power Core, etc.) while being exposed to minimal defensive fire. Their extended range makes this easier than with standard Zookas.

It should be noted that Vampire Zookas deal significantly less damage than regular Zookas, which means they destroy buildings much more slowly and would take considerably longer to execute strategies such as Smoky Zooka.

text.title: Как обороняться
lines: Defenses that stall are extremely effective against Vampire Zookas. Since they must deal damage to heal, any interruption to their attacks significantly reduces their survivability.

Shock Launchers and Critter Launchers are especially strong. Critters absorb hits and delay healing, often resulting in the Vampire Zookas being eliminated if no Medkit is deployed.Needs to be confirmed
Flotsam Cannons are highly effective, as they force the Vampire Zookas to move. While repositioning, they cannot heal and become vulnerable to normally non-lethal defenses.
The Hot Pot can also pressure them effectively, though it is vulnerable to a well-timed Shock Bomb.
Mortars high per-shot splash damage can weaken Vampire Zookas enough for other defenses to finish them off, especially when they advance between buildings.

Use non-defensive Buildings as bait to control their positioning. Place clusters of Mines in front of those buildings to punish movement. Since they cannot heal while moving, mine clusters are particularly effective.

text.title: Интересное
lines: The name 'Zooka' is a stylized version of 'bazooka', which is the weapon they use.
You can have a maximum of 120 Vampire Zookas in a complete set of fully upgraded Landing Crafts.
Vampire Zooka's artwork is based on the Zooka's legacy appearance and current icon.
The Vampire Zooka was quickly removed on the day it was released, October 18, 2020, due to unspecified game issues that arose from its implementation.
A maxed Vampire Zooka deals less damage than a Level 14 Zooka, but at the same time it has triple the amount of health.

text.title: Коротко
lines: The Zombie Rifleman was a planned Proto Troop.

When destroyed, the Zombie Rifleman will respawn immediately once with halved stats. Its resurrected self does not seem to be affected by Flares or any form of healing, but is otherwise mostly identical to the regular Rifleman.
The resurrected Zombie is considered NPC unit.

text.title: Как атаковать
lines: Zombie Riflemen are effective when deployed in large numbers, as they can be used similarly to regular Riflemen. Despite having weak stats as Revived Zombies, they can be deadly against point defenses defenses like Boom Cannons, or even shield large units like Tanks. However, they can be quickly deleted by area defenses like Machine Guns, Mortars, Flamethrowers, Rocket Launchers and Shock Launchers, and spreading them out does have its risks unless the area defenses can be neutralized in time. Mines are also equally concerning, since the Zombie Rifleman's ability to resurrect himself with lower stats allows them to achieve even more value.

text.title: Как обороняться
lines: A group of Zombie Riflemen's worst enemy is the Rocket Launcher, so place it well behind other defenses.

The Mortar is effective in taking out large numbers of Riflemen, but it fires very slowly. Having a Machine Gun in front of a Mortar will cause the Zombie Riflemen to target the Machine Gun, giving the Mortar more time to fire at the Zombie Riflemen.
Place the Mortar behind various buildings so that it is difficult for the Zombie Riflemen to reach the Mortar without having any casualties, the same goes for any other slow-firing defense.
Zombie Riflemen are vulnerable to fast firing defenses such as Sniper Towers, Machine Guns, and Flamethrowers, so place them strategically.

Cannons and Boom Cannons can easily one-shot kill Zombie Riflemen but can be swarmed by large groups of Zombie Riflemen so be sure protect them with Sniper Towers, Machine Guns, Flamethrowers, Rocket Launchers or Shock Launchers.
Place your Mines well. Groups of them can kill Zombie Riflemen quickly if the attacker ignores them.

Some very good Prototype Defenses against Zombie Riflemen include Shock Blasters, Hot Pots, Microwav'rs and Flotsam Cannons. All of these are capable of defeating hordes of Zombie Riflemen quickly, but they can also prove to be prime targets for Shock Bombs.

text.title: Интересное
lines: You could have a maximum of 248 Zombie Riflemen in a complete set of fully upgraded Landing Crafts.

The Zombie Rifleman has the longest hiatus between its appearance in the game files and its official confirmation as an existing Troop. It then took another year before the Troop was officially declared scrapped.

text.title: Коротко
lines: Clone Rifleman is a Proto Troop that is unlocked after building the Proto Troop Workshop.
The Clone Rifleman has identical behavior to the standard Rifleman.
When destroyed, the Clone Rifleman splits into two clones, which produce two more when those clones are destroyed. Clones have weaker stats than their predecessors.
Clone Rifleman behaves identically to a Rifleman. However, spawned clones are not affected by Flares or any form of healing.
The Clone Riflemen first appeared in Warships Season 13.
The spawned clones are considered NPC units.

text.title: Как атаковать
lines: Clone Riflemen are effective when deployed in large numbers, as they can be used effectively in the same way as Rifleman. Despite boasting weak stats on clones, each Clone Rifleman essentially equates to having 4 units for just one housing space, making them deadly versus single-target defenses like Boom Cannons.

Another great strategy is Clone Rifle-Medic. Clone Riflemen have moderate health, so Medics will be able to heal up most of the damage that the Clone Riflemen take from splash damage defenses. Medics' healing does have a splash effect, so they can heal Clone Riflemen faster than any other unit (though high-level defenses can eventually overpower the healing).

A third popular strategy with Clone riflemen is the Clone Rifle-Zooka strategy. This strategy is very weak to splash defenses due to the high amount of troops and relatively low health per troop, but this is a devastating tactic when combined with high-level Medkits and/or Medics or when used against a base with low level or at least very few splash defenses. Using Smoke Screens can also help to flank the Clone Riflemen and Zookas around defenses and to the Headquarters.
Clone Riflemen are weak against Machine Guns, Mortars, Flamethrowers, Rocket Launchers and Shock Launchers as these defenses are multi-target, meaning that they excel at damaging groups of enemies.
You can allow Clone Riflemen to spread out as much as possible to minimize the effect of these defenses. However, spreading out too much will expose them to fire from too many defenses!
Due to their large numbers and short range, Clone Riflemen can be used to protect Tanks from Cannons and Boom Cannons.
Use a Barrage on large groups of Mines to prevent them from killing your Clone Riflemen quickly. If you have Critters, it can be a good alternative if Barrage gets too expensive.

text.title: Как обороняться
lines: A group of Clone Riflemen's worst enemy is the Rocket Launcher, so place it well behind other defenses.

The Mortar is effective in taking out large numbers of Riflemen, but it fires very slowly. Having a Machine Gun in front of a Mortar will cause the Clone Riflemen to target the Machine Gun, giving the Mortar more time to fire at the Clone Riflemen.
Place the Mortar behind various buildings so that it is difficult for the Clone Riflemen to reach the Mortar without having any casualties, the same goes for any other slow-firing defense.
Clone Riflemen are vulnerable to fast firing defenses such as Sniper Towers, Machine Guns, and Flamethrowers, so place them strategically.

Cannons and Boom Cannons can easily one-shot kill Clone Riflemen but can be swarmed by large groups of Clone Riflemen so be sure protect them with Sniper Towers, Machine Guns, Flamethrowers, Rocket Launchers or Shock Launchers.
Place your Mines well. Groups of them can kill Clone Riflemen quickly if the attacker ignores them.

Some very good Prototype Defenses against Clone Riflemen include Shock Blasters, Hot Pots, Microwav'rs and Flotsam Cannons. All of these are capable of defeating hordes of Clone Riflemen quickly, but they can also prove to be prime targets for Shock Bombs.

text.title: Интересное
lines: You can have a maximum of 248 Clone Riflemen in a complete set of fully upgraded Landing Crafts.
You can effectively have a total of 992 Clone Riflemen on the battlefield. The initial 248 die to spawn 496 clones and those clones die to spawn another 992.
Along with the Undercover Rifleman and the Seeker, the Clone Rifleman was one of the first Proto Troops available in the Bunker during Warships Season 78.
Because of a bug, the Clone Rifleman started out at a higher level than the other Proto Troops after the introduction of the Proto Troop Workshop.
The infinite Clone Rifleman bug was fixed on 25 June 2026.
Before 15 September 2026, Clone Rifleman's Clones were always Level 1, and a resurrected Clone Rifleman would spawn Clones upon death.
